# API reference — `logic.src.tracking`

63 modules.

### `logic.src.tracking.__init__`

WSTracker — centralized MLFlow-style experiment tracking for WSmart-Route.

- `init()` — Initializes the global experiment Tracker.
- `init_worker()` — Attaches a worker sub-process to a specific parent Run.

### `logic.src.tracking.attention_buffer`

Runtime attention ring-buffer for decoder introspection (§A.2 Option A).

- **class `AttentionRingBuffer`** — Fixed-capacity ring-buffer for encoder attention snapshots.
- `install_attention_ring_buffer()` — Register persistent forward hooks that append to ``buffer``.
- `ensure_attention_buffer()` — Attach a ring-buffer and persistent hooks to ``model`` when possible.

### `logic.src.tracking.database.__init__`

Database management and analytics for WSTracker.

### `logic.src.tracking.database.__main__`

Entrypoint for the tracking database CLI.

### `logic.src.tracking.database.cmd_stats`

Stats and metrics subcommands for the tracking database CLI.

- `stats_database()` — Prints a comprehensive statistical dashboard for the tracking database.
- `metrics_summary()` — Prints a detailed evolution summary for one or more metric keys.

### `logic.src.tracking.database.commands`

Database management commands for the WSmart-Route tracking store.

- `inspect_database()` — Prints a high-level summary of the tracking database.
- `clean_database()` — Removes all experiments and runs, resetting the database to empty.
- `compact_database()` — Defragments the SQLite file and performs an integrity check.
- `prune_database()` — Removes runs matching the specified criteria to prevent DB bloating.
- `export_run()` — Exports all data for a specific run into a JSON file.

Shared database connection utilities for tracking database commands.

SQL loader utility for the tracking database CLI.

- `load_sections()` — Parses a SQL file with -- [section_name] markers into a dictionary.

### `logic.src.tracking.helpers.__init__`

Support utilities and helper functions for the WSTracker system.

### `logic.src.tracking.helpers.lightning_helpers`

Helper functions and utilities for the WSTracker Lightning integration.

- `register_monitoring_hooks()` — Configures monitoring hooks on the module based on settings.
- `log_hook_stats_to_run()` — Processes and logs accumulated hook statistics to the WSTracker run.
- `remove_monitoring_hooks()` — Detaches and clears all registered monitoring hooks from the model.
- `run_periodic_visualisations()` — Dispatches all scheduled visualization tasks for the current epoch.
- `log_execution_profiling_report()` — Gathers the latest profiling data and logs the report to the active run.
- `extract_metrics()` — Filters and formats metrics from a callback dictionary by prefix.
- `log_checkpoint_artifact()` — Registers best and last model checkpoints as run artifacts.

### `logic.src.tracking.hooks.__init__`

PyTorch hooks and instrumentation utilities for WSmart-Route.

- `register_hooks_with_run()` — Logs hook statistics and diagnostic summaries to a tracking Run.

### `logic.src.tracking.hooks.activation_hooks`

Activation capturing and monitoring hooks for PyTorch models.

- `add_activation_capture_hooks()` — Registers forward hooks to capture raw activations from specified layers.
- `add_dead_neuron_detector_hook()` — Detects neurons that fail to activate (remain below threshold).
- `add_activation_statistics_hook()` — Computes running statistics of activations across batches.
- `compute_activation_statistics()` — Calculates final mean and standard deviation from raw accumulated moments.
- `add_activation_sparsity_hook()` — Measures activation sparsity by counting near-zero values.
- `compute_sparsity_percentages()` — Computes final sparsity percentages from raw accumulated counts.
- `print_activation_summary()` — Renders a comprehensive diagnostic table of activation dynamics.
- `remove_all_hooks()` — Safely detaches all registered PyTorch hooks to avoid memory leaks.

### `logic.src.tracking.hooks.attention_hooks`

Attention capturing and monitoring hooks for Multi-Head Attention layers.

- `add_attention_hooks()` — Registers forward hooks on Multi-Head Attention layers to capture weights.

### `logic.src.tracking.hooks.gradient_hooks`

Gradient monitoring and diagnostic hooks for PyTorch models.

- `add_gradient_monitoring_hooks()` — Registers backward hooks to monitor gradient statistics across layers.
- `add_gradient_clipping_hook()` — Registers hooks to clip gradients per-layer during backward pass.
- `add_gradient_accumulation_hook()` — Registers hooks to track gradient accumulation statistics.
- `add_gradient_nan_detector_hook()` — Registers hooks to trap NaN/Inf values during backpropagation.
- `remove_all_hooks()` — Removes all registered hooks represented in the hook data mapping.
- `print_gradient_statistics()` — Prints a formatted summary of gradient magnitudes for analysis.

### `logic.src.tracking.hooks.memory_hooks`

Memory profiling and monitoring hooks for PyTorch models.

- `add_memory_profiling_hooks()` — Registers forward hooks to track memory usage per layer.
- `add_memory_leak_detector_hook()` — Registers hooks to detect cumulative memory growth across forward passes.
- `estimate_model_memory()` — Estimates the theoretical memory footprint of a model and training state.
- `print_memory_summary()` — Renders a formatted table of memory consumption per module.
- `optimize_batch_size()` — Heuristically searches for the maximum batch size the GPU can support.
- `remove_all_hooks()` — Detaches all PyTorch handles stored in the hook data dictionary.

### `logic.src.tracking.hooks.weight_hooks`

Weight monitoring and analysis hooks for PyTorch models.

- `add_weight_change_monitor_hook()` — Monitors weight changes during training to detect learning issues.
- `compute_weight_changes()` — Computes weight changes from the initial state captured in hook_data.
- `add_weight_distribution_monitor()` — Monitors weight distribution statistics (mean, std, min, max, sparsity).
- `add_weight_update_monitor_hook()` — Monitors raw parameter update magnitudes by wrapping the optimizer step.
- `restore_optimizer_step()` — Restores the original optimizer.step() implementation.
- `add_weight_norm_constraint_hook()` — Registers hooks to enforce maximum weight norms during training.
- `detect_weight_symmetry_breaking()` — Verifies that weights have broken symmetry from their initialization.
- `print_weight_summary()` — Renders a diagnostic summary of weight evolution and statistics.
- `analyze_weight_updates()` — Analyzes raw update magnitudes to detect training stagnation or explosion.
